stance_rationale: Pure-function and walk-forward mechanics mostly verify, but the forge package cannot be approved because realized MDD 47.68% breaches the 45% hard gate, realized turnover 6.0181 breaches the 6.0 hard cap, same-period incumbent baseline/DSR fairness is absent, and 5-spec Harvey attribution is not run.

harvey_5spec_audit.present_evidence: D_REFINE five_spec_results.json has CAPM only; forge run_all.R loads FF5 but performs no CAPM/C3/C4/FF5/FF6 regressions.

critical_concerns.description: Forge realized MDD is 47.68%, above the hard 45% gate. This is not the earlier partial-book GFC dispute; it is the actual share-based backtest drawdown in backtest_result/06_metrics.csv and forge_package_draft_PROD.json.
Forge realized annual round-trip turnover is 6.0181, above the hard 6.0 cap. The formula appears correctly round-trip, so the issue is not RF-F7 formula inflation but a true hard-constraint fail.
Same-period incumbent/MEGA05 or PG2 baseline fairness is absent. The package only compares to KOSPI200 same-period, with no same-period same-cost same-DSR-penalty incumbent strategy comparison.
5-spec Harvey regression is incomplete. CAPM-only discovery evidence exists, but forge does not emit CAPM, Carhart-3, Carhart-4, FF5, and FF6 t_NW plus DSR matrix.

DSR remains a binding fail, and forge does not show a consistent total candidate penalty applied to strategy and baseline. Alpha n_trials_eff=411 plus optimizer candidates=8 implies total search penalty needs explicit treatment.

Sharpe provenance is internally inconsistent: forge_package reports 0.8204 as primary, while forge_metrics_bundle and equity_curve title show 0.7523. The package needs one authoritative metric convention.

Artifact lineage is ambiguous: requested dir A is stale v3.6 with 83 alpha dates and no covariance, active dir B has D_PROD alpha/weights, and canonical covariance is in a third risk_PROD directory. This weakens AX-008 reproducibility.

supporting_arguments: MD5 hashes match package claims for alpha, risk, optimizer, covariance, and weights; RF-F1 is not triggered.
weights.csv has 116 unique as_of_dates, 20 names per date, sum weights equal 1, max weight 0.06821, and no long-only/bounds breach.
Active alpha_scores.parquet has 116 sig_dates from 2014-04-30 to 2023-11-30, so this is not a single-snapshot 22-year reuse.
Liquidity audit on final weights shows 0 breaches of t-1 20d TV >= 2e8 KRW, minimum observed TV20_lag about 206,988,078 KRW.
Canonical covariance.parquet is symmetric PSD with min eigenvalue 0.0968907 and condition number 100.
equity_curve.png visibly continues strategy NAV after the 2023-11 deploy cutoff, and oos_zoom_chart.png is present.
unresolved_disputes: Whether Judge can accept a handoff that explicitly fails DSR, MDD, and realized turnover gates.
Which Sharpe definition is binding: build_bt_result Charter v1.4 mean-ER Sharpe 0.8204 or run_all/metrics_bundle/chart Sharpe 0.7523.
Whether the missing same-period incumbent baseline is intentionally deferred or an RF-F4 forge-stage omission.
Whether monthly_returns.parquet is obsolete under the new daily bt_result contract or simply missing.
Which artifact namespace is canonical for Judge: qepm/stage_artifacts/WT_WT-D20260528_003, stage_artifacts/WT_D20260528_003, or stage_artifacts/WT_D20260528_003_risk_PROD.
weakest_assumption: The most fragile claim is that acknowledgment of DSR fail, MDD fail, and turnover fail is sufficient for forge handoff despite missing same-period incumbent baseline and missing 5-spec Harvey attribution.
rebuttal_required: Produce same-period same-cost same-DSR-penalty incumbent/MEGA05 or PG2 baseline comparison.
Run and emit full CAPM, Carhart-3, Carhart-4, FF5, and FF6 regression matrix with t_NW, alpha_monthly, and DSR.
Resolve hard-gate failures: MDD 47.68% and realized turnover 6.0181 must be fixed or formally marked non-graduatable.
Harmonize Sharpe provenance across forge_package, forge_metrics_bundle, charts, and backtest_result.
Declare canonical artifact paths and either emit monthly_returns.parquet or document its replacement in the forge contract.

verification_triangulation.additional_perspective: I accept the pure-function and walk-forward evidence, but reject the forge package because hard gates and forge-specific validation matrix are not closed.
